name: Public transport
summary: Bus routes and timetables for Lefkosia, Larnaka, Limassol and Paphos (GTFS), plus a live bus feed (GTFS-Realtime), from the national transport portal.

el.name: Δημόσιες συγκοινωνίες
el.summary: Διαδρομές και δρομολόγια λεωφορείων για Λευκωσία, Λάρνακα, Λεμεσό και Πάφο (GTFS), και ζωντανή τροφοδοσία λεωφορείων (GTFS-Realtime), από την εθνική πύλη μεταφορών.

publisher.name: Cyprus National Access Point for transport (Public Works Department)

licence.attribution: Cyprus National Access Point for transport (traffic4cyprus.org.cy)

update.note: Timetables up to every 3 months; the live bus feed about every 30 seconds

quality.uncertainty: Timetables are plans, not what buses actually did. The live feed has about 30 seconds delay.
known_issues: A validator report shows 1 or 2 errors in some city feeds

notes: Licence read on the portal's dataset page (opened by the research, no data downloaded yet). Each of the four cities has its own feed. Check whether the live feed needs a key before building.
restrictions: The live feed is plain HTTP on a bare IP address and the page does not say whether a key is needed
